extensionDescription.message: Opens YouTube links in TimePlayer, the accessible YouTube player for Windows.

notYouTube.message: This page isn't a YouTube video or playlist.

modeAfter.message: Add a Play in TimePlayer link after each one

modeReplace.message: Open them in TimePlayer instead of the browser

saved.message: Saved. Reload open pages to apply.

optionsHelp.message: On YouTube itself, use the toolbar button, Alt+Shift+P, or the context menu. The first time, the browser asks whether to open TimePlayer; you can let it always allow this.

signinHelp.message: Only if you want TimePlayer to use your YouTube account. Sign in to YouTube in this browser, then press the button. A file is saved to Downloads; in TimePlayer, Settings, YouTube account, choose Import a sign-in file. TimePlayer deletes the file after reading it.

exportSignin.message: Export my YouTube sign-in for TimePlayer

signinDenied.message: Not exported: the browser's permission was not given.

signinNotSignedIn.message: You are not signed in to YouTube in this browser. Sign in, then try again.

signinSaved.message: Saved to Downloads as timeplayer-youtube-signin.txt. In TimePlayer: Settings, YouTube account, Import a sign-in file.
